found_at: https://www.fillout.com/help (Fillout's docs; the largest favicon PNG it links)
notes: Fillout's app mark (two bars and a dot on its yellow tile) exists only as raster: favicon.ico, these favicon PNGs (192px is the largest; there is no 512px). The icon on fillout.com/brand and in Fillout-Brand-Assets.zip is the word 'Fillout' on the yellow tile, a wordmark. The previous SVG was a third party's AI vectorisation of this favicon (logos.composio.dev, 'SVG created with Arrow, by QuiverAI'), so it is replaced by Fillout's own raster.
